entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to return something. I think. The website was a little confusing and I'm not sure what to do.
I can certainly help you look into that. Could you tell me your name and the item you're calling about?
It's Mark Peterson. I bought some cycling shoes a while back, and they're just not working out.
Okay, I see your order, Mr. Peterson. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I... I don't know? They just hurt. I think it's where the cleats are, but every time I ride I get terrible blisters. I tried adjusting them but it didn't help. I'm just so overwhelmed by it all. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. I understand that can be frustrating. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay. I just want to know if I can get a refund. It all seems so complicated.

I've got it right here. It looks like you received the shoes 53 days ago. For standard items like these, VeloFit has a 90-day return window, so you are well within the timeframe to make a return for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. So I can send them back?

Absolutely. I've just initiated that for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. You just need to print it, box up the shoes, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll process your refund.
Wow, thank you so much, Diana. You made that so much easier than I thought it would be.
You're very welcome, Mr. Peterson. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
